card.text: Explore 2002 CE26 Primary in 3D with its published radar shape model.

introduction.text: 2002 CE26 Primary is the large spheroidal member of a near-Earth binary system, reconstructed from 2004 radar and optical light-curve data. Explore its published shape and source-derived radial heights. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery.

shape.title: Radar shape model
shape.summary: The shared grid marks unavailable imagery over the published 2002 CE26 primary radar reconstruction. No secondary is included. The north polar region was hidden or observed above 60° radar incidence. The selected pole is approximate, and display phase is arbitrary.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Color shows the original model radius minus a 1.73 km reference sphere. It includes global shape and is not height above a gravitational equipotential or independent topography. Colors are transferred from the full source surface to the displayed triangles. Only the primary is included; the north polar region is poorly constrained. Optional Sun lighting uses an approximate pole and arbitrary phase. Cartographic relief is a prepared display treatment.
